programme.title: Secrets of the Penguins
programme.desc: For two years, National Geographic explorer Bertie Gregory closely studied the tight-knit communities of some of the world's most intelligent penguins.He documented behaviors and situations that had previously been difficult to capture on camera.The series proves that penguins are much closer to humans than was previously known.These unique flightless birds are brave and adventurous, and at the same time value family bonds and friendship.Thanks to their ingenuity, they can survive in the most extreme conditions Millions of years ago, a group of penguins left the icy lands, using powerful ocean currents that carried them to distant lands.Over time, these birds adapted to living in completely different places - from deserts, through the tropics, to areas inhabited by people.The fight against adversity made them one of the most intelligent birds in the world.National Geographic explorer Bertie Gregory examines their problem-solving skills, communication methods, and motivation to explore new environments.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom: Clash of Clans Compilations
programme.desc: Sega, the exiled queen, fights to regain the throne for the Matahta herd while caring for the next generation of descendants.On the borders of the kingdom, the Western Herd bravely defends its young against the approaching danger, and a clash seems inevitable.Meanwhile, Pula, the ruler of the leopards, is faced with a tragic decision.Her partner, Blue Eyes, poses a threat to their daughter Motshidi.To secure the young leopard's future, Pula must protect her even from her own companion.

programme.title: One Strange Rock
programme.desc: A story about the creation and history of the planet, the laws governing it, its shape, the richness of flora and fauna, threats to the natural environment, natural wonders and surprising relationships.Actor Will Smith and people who have had the opportunity to spend time in space will talk about this extraordinary place in the universe.Accounts from astronauts including Mae Jemison, Mike Massimino, Leland Melvin and Chris Austin Hadfield will provide a completely new perspective on Earth.Director Darren Aronofsky and his film crew visited 45 countries and six continents.The photos were taken in, among others, the Arctic, the Himalayas, India and during the annual festival in Tarragona, Spain.Materials recorded on board the International Space Station were also used.In the following episodes, viewers will learn how oxygen is produced, the protective layers of the Blue Planet and the entire sequence of events that led to the creation of life.The topic of death, colonization, destruction, the search for alien forms and human intellect will also be discussed.

programme.title: Diary of A Teen Leopard
programme.desc: The story of Pemba the leopard, who cannot cope with hunting.His mother provides all his meals.One day, however, the leopard is injured, and the son must face his fears in order to survive.

programme.title: Animal fights
programme.desc: Unique shots of spectacular clashes involving the largest and most dangerous predators on our planet.This extraordinary series also features animals that, although seemingly gentle, are surprisingly belligerent when threatened.We will see how brave they are, among others.lions, wolves, hippos and crocodiles.We will see how much the result of the duel depends on strength and weapons such as teeth or claws, and how much on good tactics.The program used materials recorded by the best nature photographers, as well as films made by amateurs who witnessed fierce fights in the animal world.

programme.title: American Amazon

programme.title: Wild Vietnam: Season 1
programme.sub-title: The mysterious north: the land of mountain forests
programme.desc: Let's set off on a journey through the picturesque forests and majestic mountains of northern Vietnam to reach the lush, tropical Mekong River Delta.Once there, we will begin a fascinating search for the last endemic species of local fauna and flora.Even though they are discovered only several dozen years after the end of the war, many animals are still at risk of extinction.The wildlife of the country located on the Indochinese Peninsula dynamically regenerates in times of peace, restoring the former richness of its landscape.However, rapid population growth, intensive construction development, growing climate crisis and increased tourist traffic constitute new, serious challenges for this region. We visit Vietnamese forests.In spring, you can observe a variety of butterfly species there.Animals at risk of extinction have been found in the mountainous regions of the country, such as pangolins, palm cilantroes and light-headed lutungas from Cat Ba Island.The crocodile lizard, whose presence was discovered relatively recently, immediately became an object of smuggling.Saving the white-faced lutungs turned out to be a difficult challenge.The animals were in great danger, but they managed to find refuge in a nature reserve.

programme.title: Animal Fight Club
programme.desc: There is a constant struggle in the animal kingdom.Lions, elephants, polar bears and cobras engage in deadly fights.The cameras capture scenes full of tension, drama and determination.Each fight has a story behind it.An alligator boldly wanting to assert its dominance, a hungry bear fighting for food, or a fox taking part in a mating ritual - they will show their capabilities.Unique recordings show the colorful and cruel world of animals.Tactics, hidden weapons, deception - wild creatures use all possibilities and will stop at nothing to survive.

programme.title: The Wild Sides
programme.desc: The creators of the three-part series follow the fate of several families of wild animals living in the Mashatu reserve in Botswana.The production was created over two years and presents the fate of four species.Around the bed of the dried river there are a pride of lions, elephants, a leopard, jackals with offspring, and playful baboons.Every day, these creatures fight to survive and raise their offspring in difficult conditions, and their fates are inextricably linked.Macquele the leopard is a single mother who must deal with the presence of hyenas, lions and jackals, as well as a troop of baboons giving her away her position every time she hunts.A herd of elephants led by Ukwethemba searches for food and water, covering long distances.For the young Abancane elephant, life on the move is not easy.Jackals are monogamous.The male and female of this species raise their offspring together.To find food for them, they must face much larger predators.Baboons are smart, cunning and cause trouble wherever they go.Among them are Umusa and her son The creators of the three-part documentary follow the adventures of the inhabitants of the Mashatu reserve in Botswana, which is a wildlife enclave.The heroes of this action-packed story are families of leopards, elephants, jackals and baboons.They lead different lifestyles and have different survival strategies, but their fates are closely intertwined.The cameras captured scenes of carefree play of the young ones, as well as tense moments when the animals' lives were at stake.For two years, the filmmakers observed the challenges posed to the fauna by the extreme weather conditions prevailing in this part of Africa.Survive the drought The first part of the documentary story focuses on the fight for survival while waiting for rain.One of the heroines is Macquele the leopard, who raises her daughter alone.The problem for her is not only the lack of water and food, but also the threat from hyenas, lions and jackals.Drought is also deadly for elephants, which are said to have no natural enemies in the animal world.However, they use their own methods to reach the water.Thanks to them, other species also increase their chance of survival.The filmmakers also observe conflicts in a troop of baboons.It turns out that these smart and cunning monkeys often get themselves into trouble.
